{
  "testCases": [
    {
      "group": "Boundary – password length exactly 255 characters",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "String that matches the pattern '^\\$apr1\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{8}\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{22}$'",
          "description": "A password consisting of 255 ASCII 'a' characters is the typical maximum length accepted by many authentication systems. The method should handle it without error and produce a correctly formatted APR‑1 hash."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Boundary – extremely long password (5,000 characters)",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "... (truncated for brevity)"}],
          "expected": "String that matches the pattern '^\\$apr1\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{8}\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{22}$'",
          "description": "A password of length 255 characters should be processed without error and produce a valid APR‑1 hash."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Boundary – extremely long password (5000 characters)",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "a (repeated 5000 times) (truncated for brevity)"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "String that matches the pattern '^\\$apr1\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{8}\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{22}$'",
          "description": "A very long password (5000 characters) should not cause overflow or performance issues and still produce a correctly formatted APR‑1 hash."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Special characters – password containing dollar signs",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "pa$$w0rd$with$dollar"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "String that matches the pattern '^\\$apr1\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{8}\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{22}$'",
          "description": "Passwords that include the '$' character should be handled correctly without breaking the hash format."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Unicode handling – emoji characters",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "😀🚀🌟"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "String that matches the pattern '^\\$apr1\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{8}\\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{22}$'",
          "description": "Emoji characters are multi‑byte UTF‑8 sequences; the method must encode them correctly and still produce a valid APR‑1 hash."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Result structure – correct number of sections",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "anyPassword"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "Result contains exactly three '$' characters (i.e., splits into four parts: empty prefix, 'apr1', 8‑char salt, 22‑char hash).",
          "description": "Ensures the APR‑1 hash string follows the expected '$apr1$<salt>$<hash>' structure."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Result structure – salt character set validation",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "anyPassword"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "All characters of the salt (the 8 characters after the first '$apr1$') belong to the set [./0-9A-Za-z].",
          "description": "Verifies that the generated salt uses only the allowed Base64‑like character set."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "group": "Result structure – hash length validation",
      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "keyBytes",
              "value": "anyPassword"
            }
          ],
          "expected": "The hash part (the substring after the second '$') is exactly 22 characters long.",
          "description": "Confirms that the APR‑1 hash component has the correct fixed length."
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
